'''Alem "Whisper" Reesus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] gunslinger living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was mute ever since the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] cut out his tongue when he was a kid. In [[3630 BBY]] "Whisper" found himself on [[Port Nowhere]] when it was taken over by the [[Crimson Fang]] gang. Unhappy with the takeover, Whisper bided his time until he was able to send message to [[Hylo Visz]]. Hylo was working with the [[Eternal Alliance]] strike team currently liberating Port Nowhere and asked them to assist Whisper. They helped him win a firefight he was cornered in, after which Whisper in turn assisted them against [[Elarea Aldraste]]. Following the battle, though, he chose not to join the Alliance and went his own way.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alem "Whisper" Reesus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Crimson Fang" Uprising.
